actual_consumed_policy.price_range: full view uses supplied price through K; local view displays only its selected range; completed statistics retain the original K-eligible members; outside-view boundaries are omitted, not missing source data
actual_consumed_policy.scalar_x: keep actual x=K; detach historical shared x range; show only K tick and a single-cut label
actual_consumed_policy.scalar_x_padding: equal display-only margins, at least 24 screen pixels; no synthetic or future records
actual_consumed_policy.fit_y_range: explicit nondegenerate y range; check final range after callbacks
actual_consumed_policy.value_labels: each present scalar has a readable value+unit in the margin; no hover required
actual_consumed_policy.absent_value: explicit state/reason rather than an unexplained blank or zero
actual_consumed_policy.temporal_note: member actual endpoints and confirmation times differ; scalar has one observation only
actual_consumed_policy.rhythm_detail: waiting / actual recent interval median = waiting_ratio, never a probability cap
